function PID(kp,ki,kd,oMin,oMax,intLimit) return { kp=kp, ki=ki, kd=kd, intrl=0, pErr=0, oMin=oMin or -1, oMax=oMax or 1, intLimit=intLimit or 10, update=function(self,sp,pv,enable) if not enable then self.intrl=0 self.pErr=0 return 0 end local error=sp-pv self.intrl=self.intrl+error if self.intrl>self.intLimit then self.intrl=self.intLimit elseif self.intrl<-self.intLimit then self.intrl=-self.intLimit end local der=error-self.pErr self.pErr=error local output = self.kp*error+ self.ki*self.intrl+ self.kd*der if output>self.oMax then output=self.oMax elseif output<self.oMin then output=self.oMin end return output end } end toPitchPID=PID(2,0.1,2,-1,1,1) toPitchAnglePID=PID(0.005,0,1,-0.2,0.2,1) toRollPID=PID(1,0,10,-1,1,1) mX,mAlt,mY,mPitch=0,0,0,0 mRoll,mCompass,tX,tY=0,0,0,0 trgtAlt,t1,abj,laserDist=0,0,0,0 azToTarget,elToTarget,distToTarget,t2=0,0,0,0 t3=0 terrFollow=false maxFlyDist=pgn("Maximum Fly Distance (m)") if not maxFlyDist or maxFlyDist<=0 then maxFlyDist=30000 end flyDistance=maxFlyDist+random(1,floor(maxFlyDist*0.1)) function onTick() mX=gn(1) mAlt=gn(2) mY=gn(3) mPitch=gn(4) mRoll=gn(5) mCompass=gn(6) tX=gn(7) tY=gn(8) laserDist=gn(9) mSpeed=gn(10) azToTarget=gn(11) elToTarget=gn(12) distToTarget=gn(13) manualSetAltitude=gn(14) attackMode=gn(15) start=gb(1) targetFound=gb(2) if not start then tXMem=tX tYMem=tY mXMem=mX mYMem=mY manualSetAltitudeMem=manualSetAltitude attackModeMem=attackMode end if manualSetAltitudeMem~=0 and manualSetAltitudeMem>20 then setAltitude=manualSetAltitudeMem else setAltitude=pgn("Hold Altitude") end startDistToPoint=sqrt(((tXMem-mXMem)^2)+((tYMem-mYMem)^2)) actualDistToPoint=sqrt(((tXMem-mX)^2)+((tYMem-mY)^2)) dirToPoint=5*(((atan(tXMem-mX,tYMem-mY)/pi2+mCompass)%1+1.5)%1-0.5) if start then t1=t1+1 traveledDist=floor((t1*215)/60) if t1>=135 then afterStart = true toYaw=max(-0.35,min(0.35,dirToPoint)) else afterStart = false end if t1>=300 then if laserDist<500 then terrFollow=true end if terrFollow then abj=abj+3 t3=t3+1 end if laserDist>500 and abj>0 and t3>=60 then terrFollow=false t2=t2+1 if t2>=120 then abj=abj-0.5 end elseif abj<=0 then t2=0 t3=0 end end if attackMode == 0 then if t1>=300 then if traveledDist>=flyDistance then pitchCascade=0 toPitch=0 else if actualDistToPoint<2500 and actualDistToPoint>1500 and mAlt<400 then toPitch=toPitchPID:update(0.2,mPitch,start) elseif actualDistToPoint<1500 then toPitch=toPitchPID:update(-0.2,mPitch,start) else altHold=setAltitude pitchCascade=-toPitchAnglePID:update(altHold+abj,mAlt,start) toPitch=-toPitchPID:update(pitchCascade,mPitch,start) end end else altHold=setAltitude*2.5 pitchCascade=-toPitchAnglePID:update(altHold,mAlt,start) toPitch=-toPitchPID:update(pitchCascade,mPitch,start) end if targetFound and distToTarget<2000 then toYaw=azToTarget*0.35 toPitch=elToTarget*0.35 end elseif attackMode == 1 or startDistToPoint<6000 then if traveledDist>=flyDistance then pitchCascade=0 toPitch=0 else altHold=setAltitude pitchCascade=-toPitchAnglePID:update(altHold+abj,mAlt,start) toPitch=-toPitchPID:update(pitchCascade,mPitch,start) end if targetFound and distToTarget<2000 then toYaw=azToTarget*0.35 if targetFound and distToTarget<500 then toPitch=elToTarget*0.35 end end end if actualDistToPoint<2000 then radarToggle=true else radarToggle=false end toRoll=toRollPID:update(0,mRoll,start) end sn(1,toYaw) sn(2,toPitch) sn(3,toRoll) sb(1,afterStart) sb(2,radarToggle) end
